explanation.question_quote: low-set ears, upslanting palpebral fissures, and a hypoplastic fifth finger
explanation.sentence: The newborn has low-set ears, upslanting palpebral fissures, and a hypoplastic fifth finger.
This combination of findings suggests Down syndrome (trisomy 21).
A complete atrioventricular septal defect is the congenital heart defect most strongly associated with Down syndrome among the listed options.
